content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 19, p0133)**

Section 19 is mutual, but it is drafted as a **no-hire** ("agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire") and its first limb reaches **any employee of the other party**, not just personnel involved in the services. There is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. Both the no-hire mechanic and the all-personnel scope are walk-away items under NOSOLICIT, so the clause fails the fallback and binds us as customer.

Redline (validated, fallback level): recast as a mutual 12-month **non-solicitation** limited to personnel directly involved in the services, measured from the end of that involvement, with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches — mirroring approved precedent seed-nosolicit.
